caption: The drawing features four distinct views of brass or gold-colored metal hardware, set against a plain, light beige background. At the top is a decorative escutcheon plate with an ornate, symmetrical shape, featuring curving ends and a central keyhole, with two screw holes on either side. Below it and to the center, there is a small, similarly colored, oval-shaped lift or thumb piece with two curving extensions. Directly underneath, the largest object is a decorative handle with a matching ornate backplate; it has two large round knobs affixed to each end of the plate, and a curved handle extends between them, pivoting in front of the plate. To the right of the handle, there is a side view of the handle and plate, showing the handle projecting outward. The objects are shaded to indicate a metallic, reflective surface. At the bottom left corner, there is a linear scale for measurement, and the name "JANET RIZA" is written below it. The entire drawing is framed by a thin rectangular border.
title: Drawer Pull
